# Save/Unsave Item Feature Implementation
## Summary Successfully implemented the complete save/unsave item functionality for the LocateMe app.
## What Was Implemented
### 1. **Backend Verification** ✅ The backend already had all necessary endpoints: - `POST /api/items/save` - Save an item (with "can't save own items" validation) - `DELETE /api/items/save/:itemId` - Unsave an item - `GET /api/items/saved` - Get all saved items - Items returned include `is_saved` boolean flag
### 2. **New Icon Created** ✅ - Created `ic_bookmark_outline.xml` - Hollow bookmark icon for unsaved items - Existing `ic_bookmark.xml` - Filled bookmark icon for saved items
### 3. **Data Model Updates** ✅ **File: `Item.kt`** - Added `isSaved: Boolean = false` field to Item model - Created `SaveItemRequest` data class for API calls
### 4. **API Service Updates** ✅ **File: `ApiService.kt`** - Added `saveItem()` endpoint - Added `unsaveItem()` endpoint - Added `getSavedItems()` endpoint
### 5. **ItemDetails Activity** ✅ **File: `ItemDetails.kt`** - Bookmark button now shows filled/hollow icon based on save status - Click to toggle save/unsave with API call - Shows toast messages: "Item saved" / "Item unsaved" - Handles backend validation (can't save your own items) - Updates icon immediately after successful save/unsave
### 6. **SavedItems Activity** ✅ **File: `SavedItems.kt`** - Replaced mock data with real API integration - Fetches saved items from backend on load - Shows loading spinner while fetching - Shows "No saved items yet" when empty - Uses ItemAdapter for consistent UI - Refreshes on resume (when coming back from ItemDetails)
### 7. **SavedItems Layout** ✅ **File: `activity_saved_items.xml`** - Added ProgressBar for loading state - Added TextView for empty state - Wrapped in FrameLayout for proper layering
### 8. **Home Activity** ✅ **File: `Home.kt`** - Added `onResume()` to refresh items when returning from ItemDetails - This ensures save status is updated in the list
## User Flow
### Saving an Item from Home: 1. User browses items in Home screen 2. Clicks on an item → Opens ItemDetails 3. If item is **not saved**: Shows hollow bookmark icon 4. User clicks bookmark → Item saves → Icon becomes filled 5. Toast shows "Item saved" 6. User goes back to Home → Item list refreshes with updated save status
### Unsaving an Item: 1. User opens a saved item from Home or SavedItems 2. ItemDetails shows filled bookmark icon 3. User clicks bookmark → Item unsaves → Icon becomes hollow 4. Toast shows "Item unsaved" 5. If user goes back to SavedItems → Item removed from list
### Viewing Saved Items: 1. User goes to Profile → Clicks "Saved Items" 2. SavedItems screen loads all saved items from backend 3. Items displayed using same card layout as Home 4. Clicking any item opens ItemDetails with filled bookmark 5. Can unsave from ItemDetails 6. Returns to SavedItems → List refreshes automatically
## Backend Protection - Users **cannot save their own items** (backend validates this) - If attempted, backend returns: "You cannot save your own items" - MyItems page doesn't need save button since users can't save own items
## Technical Details
### API Request Examples:
**Save Item:** ```json POST /api/items/save Authorization: Bearer <token> Body: { "itemId": 123 } ```
**Unsave Item:** ```json DELETE /api/items/save/123 Authorization: Bearer <token> ```
**Get Saved Items:** ```json GET /api/items/saved Authorization: Bearer <token> ```
### State Management: - `Item.isSaved` field tracks save status - Updated locally on successful API call for instant UI feedback - Refreshed from server on page resume for data consistency
## Testing Checklist - [ ] Open Home → Click item → See hollow bookmark (if not saved) - [ ] Click bookmark → Should save and show filled icon - [ ] Go back to Home → Item should still show as saved - [ ] Go to Profile → Saved Items → Should see the saved item - [ ] Click saved item → Should show filled bookmark - [ ] Click bookmark to unsave → Should show hollow icon - [ ] Go back to SavedItems → Item should be removed - [ ] Try to save your own item from MyItems → Should show error message
## Files Modified 1. `app/src/main/res/drawable/ic_bookmark_outline.xml` (NEW) 2. `app/src/main/java/com/mustafafaraz/locateme/data/model/Item.kt` 3. `app/src/main/java/com/mustafafaraz/locateme/data/api/ApiService.kt` 4. `app/src/main/java/com/mustafafaraz/locateme/ItemDetails.kt` 5. `app/src/main/java/com/mustafafaraz/locateme/SavedItems.kt` 6. `app/src/main/res/layout/activity_saved_items.xml` 7. `app/src/main/java/com/mustafafaraz/locateme/Home.kt`
## Known Android Studio Warnings Some warnings about "unused" functions are normal - the IDE doesn't always recognize Retrofit API calls as "used". The code is correct and will work fine.
If you see layout errors about `progress_bar` or `empty_view` not found, just rebuild the project (Build → Rebuild Project) to clear the cache.
## Next Steps (Optional Enhancements) 1. Add swipe-to-delete in SavedItems for quick unsaving 2. Add save count badge in Profile stats 3. Add animation when bookmark icon changes state 4. Show save status indicator on Home item cards (small bookmark badge)
